title: Factorization Algebras and Quantum Groups from Generalized Poisson Sigma Models
summary: In this work we introduce and study a family of holomorphic--topological field theories, which we call generalized Poisson sigma models. These theories are higher-dimensional analogues of the two-dimensional Poisson sigma model, with target data encoded by shifted chiral Poisson structures. We investigate their relationship with deformation quantizations of holomorphic--topological factorization algebras. Along the way, we give a systematic construction of extended objects, including interfaces, enriched boundaries and defects based on relevant notions in derived algebraic geometry. We…
